fusions.name: Far Scatter
fusions.desc: Drops a spore pod on a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 14 nature damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and gives it Rot for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 4.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Downdraft
fusions.desc: Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back. A wingbeat drives spores through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 7 wind damage to everything in it and giving it Rot for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lichen Nest
fusions.desc: Grows a nest up to 5 tiles away. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally inside it.

fusions.name: Thermal Drift
fusions.desc: Every few paces you travel, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
